type: secondary metric added; primary metric unchanged
definition: For questions whose reference answer is yes or no, a boxed 1/true is read as yes and 0/false as no; all other answers are scored exactly as the primary metric.
evidence: outputs/feedback_check_qwen35_2b_base_v1 (20 feedback questions): Qwen3.5-2B boxed 1/0 in 7 of 20 answers while its text stated yes/no; primary 5/20, secondary 9/20.
timing: Recorded before any test-set generation by any system.
use: Reported for every system alongside the primary metric. Phase 3 correctness checks keep the strict primary metric, so admitted training targets use worded answers.
